newsitem.title: POLAND: Moroccan student knifes two to death in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan student knifes two to death in Poland.

text.p: A Moroccan student knifed two people to death and wounded five others in southern Poland after a row with compatriots, police said on Monday.

The student, identified only as 24-year-old Rashid D., wounded a fellow Moroccan with a switchblade on Sunday evening in the apartment the man shared with a Moroccan woman, police spokesman Stanislaw Stygar said.

Running out of the apartment, he then stabbed other people he met on the way, two of whom died. One was fighting for his life in hospital. "We do not know the motives for the killer's action," Stygar said.
The dead were a 60-year-old man, who had come to check on what was happening in the apartment, and a 17-year-old girl who happened to be passing on the street.
Police arriving at the scene, in the southern city of Wroclaw where Rashid D. was a technical college student, fired warning shots and then wounded him in the leg and chest.
